entities.summary: Eric Joseph Winston is an American former professional football offensive tackle. He played in college at the University of Miami and was selected by the Houston Texans in the third round of the 2006 NFL draft. Winston also played for the Kansas City Chiefs, Arizona Cardinals, and Cincinnati Bengals. He was the president of the National Football League Players Association (NFLPA) from 2014 to 2020.
